title: August 21, 2026 SmackDown Results
seoTitle: August 21, 2026 SmackDown Results: Title Defenses & Chaos
subtitle: The event featured a title defense, outside interference, and backstage attacks.
excerpt: Check out the main events and results from Friday Night SmackDown held on August 21, 2026.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The SmackDown episode held on August 21, 2026, caught wrestling fans' attention with standout matches, title defenses, and decisive interferences in the company's top championship picture. The event took place in Toronto, featuring CM Punk and Kevin Owens battling for the world title.

Sami Zayn's Interference in the Main Event

The match for the Undisputed WWE Championship between champion CM Punk and Kevin Owens took place in Toronto. During the bout, Sami Zayn appeared to try and help Owens, but the situation took an unexpected turn when Owens refused the assistance.

Following the refusal, Zayn struck Owens with the championship belt, allowing CM Punk to hit his finishing move and win the match. Right after the bell, Zayn attacked both Punk and Owens, screaming that Punk had stolen his title.

Warning Regarding Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton

During the show, Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton traded verbal jabs in a heated argument. The situation led General Manager Nick Aldis to declare that neither man will receive another title opportunity if they make any physical contact before Sunday's event.

Tag Team Title Retention

In the tag team division, champions Tama Tonga and Talla Tonga defended their belts in a rematch against Damian Priest and R-Truth. With Haku present and Damian Priest neutralized at ringside, the champions hit the decisive blow to defeat R-Truth and retain the titles.

Surprise Attack and Canceled Debut

Blake Monroe abruptly canceled her in-ring debut on the show. Instead of competing, she launched a surprise attack on Giulia, capping off the assault with the Neutralizer.

United States Title Challenge

United States Champion Baron Corbin initially denied Trick Williams a match for his belt. After a renewed argument involving Williams and Lil Yachty, Corbin changed his mind and offered Williams a rematch at Sunday's event, provided that Lil Yachty can last five minutes in the ring against the current champion.

Women's Division Action

Lash Legend earned a victory over Tiffany Stratton using the Lash Extension. Right after the pinfall, interim Women's Champion Chelsea Green appeared armed with a kendo stick to rescue her ally from an attack orchestrated by The Irresistible Forces.
